# Case 1: simple 2x2, asymmetric directed weights
{"directed":[[0,0.5],[0.2,0]]}
@ undirected weight for (0,1) is max(0.5, 0.2) = 0.5
{"edges":{"0":[{"to":1,"weight":0.5}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":0.5}]},"totalWeight":0.5}

# Case 2: 3x3, multiple asymmetric edges
{"directed":[[0,1,0],[0,0,2],[3,0,0]]}
@ pairs: (0,1)->max(1,0)=1; (0,2)->max(0,3)=3; (1,2)->max(2,0)=2; totalWeight = 1+3+2 = 6
{"edges":{"0":[{"to":1,"weight":1},{"to":2,"weight":3}],"1":[{"to":0,"weight":1},{"to":2,"weight":2}],"2":[{"to":0,"weight":3},{"to":1,"weight":2}]},"totalWeight":6}

# Case 3: isolated node preserved, zero edges skipped
{"directed":[[0,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,0,0]]}
@ only pair (1,2) has non-zero max weight = 1; node 0 remains with empty adjacency
{"edges":{"0":[],"1":[{"to":2,"weight":1}],"2":[{"to":1,"weight":1}]},"totalWeight":1}

# Case 4: negative and zero weights skipped
{"directed":[[0,-1,2],[-2,0,-3],[2,-4,0]]}
@ (0,1): max(-1,-2)=-1<=0 skip; (1,2): max(-3,-4)=-3<=0 skip; (0,2): max(2,2)=2>0 keep
{"edges":{"0":[{"to":2,"weight":2}],"1":[],"2":[{"to":0,"weight":2}]},"totalWeight":2}
